messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

A customer brings in a defective computer and the CRS checks the defect and hands out a repair cost calculation back. If the customer decides that the costs are acceptable, the process continues, otherwise she takes her computer home unrepaired. The ongoing repair consists of two activities, which are executed, in an arbitrary order. The first activity is to check and repair the hardware, whereas the second activity checks and configures the software. After each of these activities, the proper system functionality is tested. If an error is detected another arbitrary repair activity is executed, otherwise the repair is finished.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"

                  id="Definitions_ComputerRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.org/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="Camunda Modeler"

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="Computer Repair Service" processRef="Process_ComputerRepair" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ComputerRepair" isExecutable="true">
    
    <!-- Start Event -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DefectiveComputerBrought" name="Defective computer brought in">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToCRSCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <!-- CRS Checks Defect & Calculates Cost -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckDefectAndCalculateCost" name="Check defect and hand out repair cost calculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToCRSCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRSCheckToAcceptanceGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Decision: Costs Acceptable? -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CostsAcceptable" name="Costs acceptable?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRSCheckToAcceptanceGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CostsAccepted</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CostsRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- End Event: Unrepaired -->
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ComputerTakenHomeUnrepaired" name="Computer taken home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CostsRejected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Ad-Hoc Subprocess for Arbitrary Repairs -->
    <bpmn:adHocSubProcess id="SubProcess_AdHocRepair" name="Perform Repair Activities (Arbitrary Order)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CostsAccepted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubprocessToTest</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAndRepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware" />
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAndConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software" />
    </bpmn:adHocSubProcess>

    <!-- Loop Merge Gateway -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoopMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubprocessToTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ErrorDetectedLoop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LoopMergeToTestSystem</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Test System Functionality -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TestSystemFunctionality" name="Test proper system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LoopMergeToTestSystem</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestToResultGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Gateway: Error Detected? -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorDetected" name="Error detected?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestToResultGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoError</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ErrorDetectedLoop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- End Event: Repaired -->
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished successfully">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoError</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToCRSCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_DefectiveComputerBrought" targetRef="Task_CheckDefectAndCalculateCost" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRSCheckToAcceptanceGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefectAndCalculateCost" targetRef="Gateway_CostsAcceptable" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CostsAccepted" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CostsAcceptable" targetRef="SubProcess_AdHocRepair" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CostsRejected" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CostsAcceptable" targetRef="EndEvent_ComputerTakenHomeUnrepaired" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubprocessToTest" sourceRef="SubProcess_AdHocRepair" targetRef="Gateway_LoopMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoopMergeToTestSystem" sourceRef="Gateway_LoopMerge" targetRef="Task_TestSystemFunctionality" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestToResultGateway" sourceRef="Task_TestSystemFunctionality" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoError" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="EndEvent_RepairFinished" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ErrorDetectedLoop" name="Yes (Execute repair task)" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="Gateway_LoopMerge" />

  </bpmn:process>
